paragraphs: By leveraging advanced data science techniques, I can contribute to Heathrow's mission of improving airport operations and informing business decisions. In my previous role, I built scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker. This experience involved creating robust and scalable models that could be easily integrated into existing systems, ensuring that Heathrow can make data-driven decisions more efficiently.

Additionally, I proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, and GitHub Actions CI for continuous integration. This tool was presented in a live stakeholder demo, demonstrating its potential to enhance decision-making processes in a Madrid-based product start-up context.
I have not used XGBoost yet, but I am eager to explore its capabilities in similar projects.
